name: Yü Group PLC
summary: Yü Group PLC, through its subsidiaries, supplies energy and utility solutions to small and medium-sized enterprises, and corporate customers in the United Kingdom. The company supplies electricity, gas, water, and other utility solutions. It also provides electric vehicle charge points; meter installations to connect properties under construction; and energy insights and advice services. The company was formerly known as Yoda Newco 1 Limited and changed its name to Yü Group PLC in February 2016. Yü Group PLC was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Nottingham, the United Kingdom.
